test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

The farmer asked his wife why she was upset when he had just returned from the city.

options.text: The farmer said to his wife, "Why are you so upset when I just returned from the city?"
The farmer said to his wife, "Why did you upset when I returned from the city?"
The farmer said to his wife, "Why are you upset when I have just returned from the city?"
The farmer said to his wife, "Why are you upset when I was just returned from the city?"

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The farmer asked his wife why she was upset when he had just returned from the city.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"why she was upset" becomes "Why are you upset"**
 
 
• Indirect question "why she was upset" is converted to direct question "Why are you upset" in present tense.
 
• Pronoun "she" is changed to "you" to suit the direct speech format.
 
 
 
• **"when he had just returned" becomes "when I have just returned"**
 
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "I" for direct speech.
 
• Past perfect tense "had just returned" is converted to present perfect "have just returned" to match the current timeline of the dialogue.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "The farmer asked"
 
• Converted to: "The farmer said to his wife" to introduce the direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Why" and ends with a question mark "?".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The farmer said to his wife, ‘Why are you upset when I have just returned from the city?’"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The farmer said to his wife, ‘Why are you so upset when I just returned from the city?’" 

 
 
• Incorrect as "so" adds unnecessary emphasis not present in the indirect speech.
 
• Past perfect "had just returned" is incorrectly replaced with past tense "just returned."
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "The farmer said to his wife, ‘Why did you upset when I returned from the city?’" 
 
 
• Grammatical error: "did you upset" is incorrect, should be "are you upset."
 
• Tense mismatch in "returned" instead of "have just returned."
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The farmer said to his wife, ‘Why are you upset when I was just returned from the city?’" 
 
 
• Incorrect use of passive voice "was just returned," which changes the meaning of the sentence.
